Every journey begins with a single move.

Jack the Ripper - John Leslie Stevenson

Verzila (segment  "Workmate") / buyer at the market (segment "Operation Y") (uncredited)

I want you to be the happiest person in the world.

Chantal, la sirène / Alice de Nice

The star teaming you'll never forget!

Sometimes there's a terrible penalty for telling the truth.

Mahmoud Bey - Member of the People’s Assembly
